# System packages (Fedora/RPM names). Format: <package> [platform:<selector>]
# Build-time compilers are needed for any wheel that has to compile from source.
gcc                [platform:rpm compile]
python3-devel      [platform:rpm compile]
libffi-devel       [platform:rpm compile]
openssl-devel      [platform:rpm compile]
libxml2-devel      [platform:rpm compile]
libxslt-devel      [platform:rpm compile]
libssh-devel       [platform:rpm compile]

# Runtime
git                [platform:rpm]
openssh-clients    [platform:rpm]
sshpass            [platform:rpm]
rsync              [platform:rpm]
iputils            [platform:rpm]
bind-utils         [platform:rpm]
unzip              [platform:rpm]
jq                 [platform:rpm]
libssh             [platform:rpm]
libxml2            [platform:rpm]
libxslt            [platform:rpm]
